name: 142-websocket.1 — a connection built bare, opened on purpose, and heard
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 142.1: hafen.websocket() as the collection of live connections, :connection(url) built bare with its setters and refusals, :connect() as the gate and the dispatch under websocket.connect and the network block, the cap of eight, :close() and its codes, and Open, Close and Error heard on the step against an echo service and a host that does not resolve.
